newsitem.title: USA: Paxar Corp completes Monarch purchase.
newsitem.headline: Paxar Corp completes Monarch purchase.

text.p: Paxar Corp said on Monday that it has completed the purchase of Monarch Marking Systems Inc.

Paxar increased its stake to 100 percent from 49 percent by buying Odyssey Partners LP and senior management's interests in Monarch for $130 million in cash, warrants, options and shares of Paxar common stock, it said.
Funding for the deal came from a new $280 million bank credit agreement with Fleet Bank as the arranger and agent, Paxar said.
The six-year credit agreement replaces a five-year, $60 million credit facility, Paxar said.
Paxar said it plans to make an equity contribution of $33.75 million to permit Monarch to redeem 30 percent or $30 million of its of its 12.5 percent unsecured senior notes due 2003.
After this redemption, Paxar said it will conduct a tender offer to redeem the remaining $70 million of this series of notes.
